name: OSS_EVENT_TRANSACTION_DETAILS
description: When the corresponding profile option is enabled to log the change events on tables like subscription, products and associations, and based on the configurations done on OSS_EVENT_CONFIG, whenever an action is performed, the details are logged in this table.

columns.name: EVENT_TRANSACTION_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Primary key, unique identifier of the event transaction details.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_ID
columns.description: Subscription on which operation was performed.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_PRODUCT_ID
columns.description: Subscription Product on which operation was performed.

columns.name: PRODUCT_ASSOCIATION_ID
columns.description: Subscription Product Association on which operation was performed.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: To identify the Action against which the log was made for, this is referred from table OSS_EVENT_TRANSACTIONS.

columns.name: OPERATION
columns.description: To identify the type of operation that is performed. Example: UPDATE, INSERT, DELETE.

columns.name: CHANGED_ATTRIBUTE
columns.description: To identify the attribute that is been changed during this transaction.

columns.name: OLD_VALUE
columns.description: The old value of the attribute that was there before for the CHANGED_ATTRIBUTE column.

columns.name: NEW_VALUE
columns.description: The new value of the CHANGED_ATTRIBUTE that is modified to.

columns.name: SOURCE_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: To identify the life cycle operation in which this record was modified.

columns.name: SOURCE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID
columns.description: Subscription id of the source for flows like Amend, Resume, Renew.

columns.name: SOURCE_PRODUCT_ID
columns.description: Subscription product id of the source for flows like Amend, Resume, Renew.

columns.name: SOURCE_ASSOCIATION_ID
columns.description: Subscription product association id of the source for flows like Amend, Resume, Renew.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
